data.long_meaning: Originating from Old English, Vernon means 'foreign settler' or 'settlement of the foreigner'. This name has been popular in England since the Middle Ages, and was often given to children born in settlements or to those with foreign ancestry. The name Vernon carries the meaning “Foreign settler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vernon usually hope their child will grow to embody foreign settler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
